FOUNDATION PERSONNEL RECORD — CLASS D

Designation: D-9341
Source:
state correctional intake, capital sentence commuted to Foundation custody

Assigned: Site-104, Floor 3 testing pool
Scheduled procedures: SCP-914 object testing (Mondays),
Notes: Subject displays above-average situational awareness and below-average deference. Flagged by Dr. Voss as
'a survivor type — recommend against assigning to terminal-outcome tests while the observation rotation is understaffed. We need blinkers we can trust.'
